description:
Welcome to Haushalt-und-Genuss!

We are a passionate team of experts who don’t just run e-commerce – we live it. Our goal is to dominate niches where genuine quality and real solutions are in demand. For our publishers, this means: Products with substance, extremely high repurchase rates, and a partnership at eye level.

Your Revenue Boost: Our Highlights

  • The Niche Hero – Gelling Aid 4:1 (Erythritol-based): Our absolute bestseller and a true mega-niche product! We offer a full-scale jam setting mix with only 10 kcal, completely free from added industrial sugar.
    • Target Groups: Perfect for the Low-Carb and Keto communities, diabetics, athletes in the cutting phase, and anyone looking to consciously reduce or avoid sugar without sacrificing taste.
    • Revenue Factor: Once customers try our gelling aid, they stick with it. We see an extraordinarily high repurchase rate—on average, customers buy 10 packs at a time in their follow-up orders!
  • Exclusive Brand Power starting May: In May, we are expanding our range to include well-known brand manufacturers. What makes it special: We hold exclusive distribution rights for some of these products. This means for you: Low competition and exclusive content for your community!
  • Growth & International Reach: We currently serve Germany and Austria. Starting in June, we are officially expanding into the Netherlands. Please note that our product range may vary slightly per country due to distribution rights—we are happy to provide guidance on this!

Why You Should Start Now:

  • Attractive Commission: We are launching with a strong standard of 8% commission on every sale.
  • High-End Marketing Assets: We won’t leave you hanging. In the coming days, we will upload fresh web banners and professional promo videos so you can start immediately with high-performing material.
  • Growing Together: We specialize in scaling merchants and products. If you are a partner who wants to hit the gas, you’ve come to the right place.

Let’s not waste any time – the canning season is just around the corner and our warehouses are ready!
payout_period: After delivery and expiry of the cancellation period (+ 5 days)
